rationale: Several subsystems change (a new WorkerHeartbeat table and migration, worker.ts writes at tick start and end, a read route, a queue-panel banner and a retry-reason tweak), but every edit is additive and best-effort, and the open questions (banner placement, 3-minute threshold) are tuning knobs that do not change what is built.

signals.blast_radius: New WorkerHeartbeat model and migration, worker.ts writes at tick start and end, a pure staleness helper, one team-authenticated read route, and ScheduledQueueSection.tsx for the banner and retry reason, plus docs
signals.unresolved: Only tuning knobs: banner placement (queue panel vs dashboard) and the 3-minute staleness threshold, neither of which changes the file list
signals.irreversibility: Additive table and migration with a down script; a heartbeat write failure is logged and never stops the loop, so reverting is a git revert plus dropping one table
